findings: Explain natural person, legal person and economic operator consistently without changing legal scope.
Audiovisual access and the payment trigger for conditional fines need source-based definitions.
Distinguish unknown sanction-to-sector mapping from whether the EAA applies; a guide clarification was added, while established area labels were retained.
Clarify what the court may order to be published under Article 68.
Confirm whether the legal-entity qualifier also applies to distributor amounts.
Clarify when the conditional fine becomes payable and what supporting supervision means.
Explain fifth-class offences and clarify the activity suspended when products remain non-compliant.
Explain audiovisual terminal equipment without widening its scope.
Clarify the non-SME category, the 5% calculation base, the serious-harm condition and the meaning of no net turnover.
Confirm whether warnings require reports of planned or completed corrective action.
Explain summary conviction and conviction on indictment; verify the actors and rights behind compliance directions and consumer court actions.
Clarify substantive violations and whether public procurement exclusions concern bidding or the scope of the law.
Verify whether the seven-day interval starts at payment, demand or imposition.
Give the verified name or remit of OSAPS.
Clarify whether marketing means sale, supply or advertising, and whether confiscation and destruction are alternatives or combined measures.
Clarify the object of restrictions and withdrawal in Regulation 22.
Confirm whether penalty year is the year the fine is imposed.
Clarify whose legal status determines the fine range.
Explain conformity marking, withdrawal versus recall, and which activity can be prohibited.
Make the offence-group maxima explicit alongside the turnover limit.
Explain disproportionate burden using the source conditions.
Confirm the relationship between the general legal-person range and the medium/large-company range; do not infer that the categories are mutually exclusive.
Clarify the supplementary fines wording without suggesting a cumulative cap.
Clarify the cross-reference to conditions and the exact overlap restriction in Section 38.
